info.title: CarLink Backend API
info.description: Email-link-only human authentication, independent SaaS staff, paid subscription snapshots and entitlements, automatic pending devices, signed edge commands, transient DTC AI, own-driver privacy/safety appeals, maintenance/compliance and fleet coverage. Production hardware/provider/concurrency acceptance remains required. Operational tenant APIs require an active paid subscription by default; billing remains reachable. Device Bearer tokens apply ONLY to edge routes. Payment retains the specified bearer callback flow; its User-Agent is not proof of origin.

get.summary: Set the CSRF cookie for a first-party frontend
get.description: Requires credentialed CORS. A subsequent state-changing request must send the XSRF token.

post.description: Returns the same response for eligible and ineligible accounts. Eligible tokens and encrypted HTML/plain-text mail intents commit together; ID-only auth-mail queue jobs deliver asynchronously. A 202 does not mean SES delivery. Normalized-email and global rate limits apply. The log transport never writes login credentials.

post.summary: Explicitly confirm a single-use login or organization signup link
post.description: Requires a browser session, its cookies and a valid X-XSRF-TOKEN header. The request Origin or Referer hostname must be configured in SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS, including the backend hostname for same-origin Swagger. Stateless requests are rejected before consuming the token. Successful confirmation commits a mandatory security email for every human stakeholder with trusted IP/source, account-local timestamp and bounded client-reported user agent/browser/platform. No geographic/device identity is inferred.

409.description: Signup plan changed or another pending signup exists; transaction rolls back without consuming the link.

get.summary: Retrieve the authenticated user, memberships and current tenant permission keys

patch.description: Active human account only; versioned self-service display name, locale and IANA timezone. A durable mandatory security email commits with the change. Does not change the authentication email or grant roles. Email copy is currently English; locale is a stored account preference.

timezone.description: Recognized IANA timezone identifier; default Asia/Kuala_Lumpur.

get.summary: List the current user's active organization memberships

patch.description: Requires organizations.write. A stale version returns 409; ownership is changed only through ownership-transfers.

get.description: Requires vehicles.read, drivers.read or devices.read according to resource. Returns cursor-paginated records in the active tenant. data.pagination includes next_cursor, previous_cursor and per_page; follow cursors until null. No pre-pagination history cap; ordering has unique tie-breakers.

post.summary: Create a vehicle, driver or device
post.description: Requires vehicles.write, drivers.write or devices.write according to resource. Registration alone does not provision broker credentials.

patch.description: Send the current version for optimistic concurrency. A stale version returns 409. Suspending a driver closes the active shift and records the closure event; broker cache invalidation is not yet implemented.

post.description: Rejects an open device installation and preserves historical records.

get.description: data.pagination includes next_cursor, previous_cursor and per_page; follow cursors until null. No pre-pagination history cap; ordering has unique tie-breakers.

post.description: Managed-device mode (default): returns 403. Organizations cannot create, activate or relink devices. Register a vehicle to generate a pending device; contact SaaS staff for installation/relinking. Legacy behavior is available only when SAAS_MANAGED_DEVICES=false. Creates an open-ended interval. The device and vehicle must belong to this organization and cannot overlap another installation.

Managed-device mode (default): returns 403. Organizations cannot create, activate or relink devices. Register a vehicle to generate a pending device; contact SaaS staff for installation/relinking. Legacy behavior is available only when SAAS_MANAGED_DEVICES=false. Returns 409 when an associated shift is active or extends beyond the proposed installation end. Close or resolve the shift first.

Requires payments.manage in the authenticated tenant. Returns the validated gateway payment URL; requesting a link does not confirm payment. Provider links are permanent; local expiry does not disable checkout, and late charges require manual reconciliation. A timeout may mean the upstream operation completed, so reconcile before retrying.

202.description: Gateway returned a valid JSON response with a payment URL. Payment remains unconfirmed unless the callback was received before this response.

payment_url.description: Validated checkout URL while the attempt is pending and not expired.

gateway_id.description: Transaction reference returned by the gateway.

get.description: Requires payments.manage. Failed with reason unconfirmed_timeout means no valid callback was recorded within the local confirmation window, not that the gateway has proven a failure. Ordinary attempts expire after 30 minutes; initial self-service signup checkout expires at the fixed 12-hour signup deadline. Expired signup tenant reads return 410; use organization-signups for lifecycle reconciliation.

post.summary: Confirm payment with a one-time callback secret
post.description: A POST with the unique per-attempt callback secret and expected User-Agent confirms payment once before its local deadline (30 minutes normally; the fixed 12-hour deadline for initial self-service signup invoices). Missing or unparseable bodies remain acceptable. If a supplied transaction response can be parsed, provided status, ID, amount and currency are checked for mismatches. The secret is a bearer credential; anyone who has it and supplies the header can claim success. Never expose or log the callback URL. At or after a signup deadline, matching authenticated callbacks are retained for manual reconciliation and return 410 without settlement; after permanent deletion the independent financial archive receives the evidence. Duplicate archived callbacks return 409; bad secrets and mismatches remain 403/422. No callback resurrects a deleted organization.

parameters.name: callbackToken
parameters.description: One-time bearer secret generated per payment attempt; never disclose or log.

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.description: Must contain Payment Gateway by Sam Sam. This header is not proof of origin.

response.description: JSON-encoded transaction object, when supplied by the gateway.
JSON-encoded transaction object, when supplied by the gateway.

schema.description: Optional body. A response field may contain a JSON-encoded transaction object; the provider does not guarantee a Content-Type or body format.

200.description: Callback consumed once and payment marked succeeded.

get.description: Requires credentials.manage. Returns credential metadata only; HMAC digests and UID fingerprints are never returned.

post.summary: Enrol an NFC fingerprint for a driver
post.description: Requires credentials.manage. UID fingerprints are low-assurance and never returned; rotation requires a migration. The fingerprint is SHA-256 of normalized UID bytes, not the raw UID.
Requires credentials.manage. Revocation takes effect for the online domain service; offline cache invalidation is not implemented.

get.description: Drivers see only their linked driver records; authorized staff can see their tenant's shifts. Returns up to 100 items.

post.description: Requires shifts.manage. This is an audited administrative action, not a driver-operated trip action.

post.summary: Create a maintenance plan with its first immutable revision
post.description: Requires maintenance.write. Calendar and estimated-distance thresholds create durable occurrences. Enabled in_app channels create inbox records; email channels queue HTML reminders for currently authorized maintenance staff. Per evaluation, only the highest newly crossed stage is emailed. Missing thresholds default to a 30-day calendar warning and a due threshold; existing cycle snapshots are unchanged.

get.summary: Get a plan and immutable revisions

post.summary: Add a plan revision for subsequent service cycles
Assign a plan to a vehicle
post.description: Requires maintenance.write. Pre-monitoring service usage remains unknown unless an explicit attested carry-in is supplied. Carry-in requires service time, an as-of time no earlier than service, and a reason.

get.summary: View vehicle service cycles and calendar due dates
get.description: Requires maintenance.read. Calendar dates use the organization's time zone and clamp month ends. Usage integrates partial speed trapezoids at service boundaries and is an estimated lower bound, never complete mileage. remaining_km is null for an unknown baseline.

post.summary: Create a work order for selected vehicle plan assignments
post.description: An open order cannot duplicate a service cycle.

get.summary: Get work order and item IDs

post.summary: Begin an order in draft or scheduled state
Cancel an open order without resetting a service cycle
Complete selected order items and advance their service cycles
post.description: Requires maintenance.complete. Same-key/body retries are idempotent; changed input conflicts. Only selected cycles advance; their open alerts resolve and post-service usage is reevaluated. Odometer readings are attested evidence, not a verified ledger. Service older than the active baseline requires unimplemented reconciliation.

cost_minor.description: Cost stored once on the first completed item.

post.description: Requires compliance.write. Vehicle calendar reminders have one warning stage and one overdue stage, with transactional in-app and HTML email intents. Each type (road tax, insurance, PUSPAKOM) defaults to 30 warning days. This registry does not determine legal eligibility.

patch.description: Requires compliance.write and the current version. Adjust warning days, name or active status per type. Subject and code cannot change. Prior open reminders are superseded; the evaluator uses the new version on its next run. Does not change verified evidence or legal coverage.

post.summary: Create a vehicle or driver obligation
post.description: Requires compliance.write. Subject and type must belong to the same tenant and agree on subject type.

get.summary: Retrieve an obligation and its current local-calendar status
get.description: The latest eligible verified coverage is used; a future-dated record is not active before its start, and genuine gaps remain expired. No file download or evidence verification is performed by this endpoint.

get.summary: List compliance status for up to 100 obligations
get.description: States include unknown, valid, due_soon, expired, suspended and not_applicable. Current verified coverage requires an authorized manual verification and evidence reference; automated document verification is not implemented.

post.description: A renewal does not change coverage until separately verified. Changed input under one idempotency key conflicts. Vehicle reminders queue in-app and HTML email intents; automatic document verification and driver-obligation reminders remain unimplemented.

evidence_reference.description: Manually managed reference to reviewed evidence; this is not a file upload.

post.summary: Verify a renewal after reviewing evidence
post.description: Requires compliance.verify and a non-empty evidence_reference on the pending record. The system does not validate the referenced document.

post.summary: Suspend a verified compliance record immediately

get.summary: List renewal cycles and action events for an obligation
List the current user's unarchived notifications
get.description: Only the authenticated user's records in the current organization are returned. Results use descending created_at and ID cursor order.

200.description: Recipient notifications and a next cursor, if any.

get.summary: Count current user's unread, unarchived notifications

patch.summary: Update read or archive state of an owned notification
patch.description: Read state is per recipient and does not acknowledge or resolve the underlying alert. Supply at least one field.

post.description: Provide either up to 100 explicit IDs or a non-future through_created_at cutoff. Explicit IDs are preferred for exact selection when timestamps are shared.

get.summary: Get the current user's preferences in this organization

patch.summary: Update the current user's notification preferences
patch.description: Quiet-hour boundaries must both be present or both null. Preferences are stored only; email delivery and scheduling are not implemented.

get.summary: Retrieve a partial estimated vehicle mileage projection
get.description: Speed-only pilot ledger. Unknown intervals are never treated as zero. Driver allocation and full coverage accounting are unavailable.

200.description: Estimated distance and baseline, with explicit partial-coverage status.

baseline_alignment.description: Partial trapezoids are integrated exactly at the baseline timestamp.

get.description: Results are bounded to 100, newest first. Unknown distance is null and is not zero.

post.description: Requires mileage.correct. A single initial baseline is supported; later calibration or adjustment is not implemented.

get.description: Requires journeys.read. Accepted telemetry feeds the detector automatically through the scheduled inbox projector. Late observations are flagged for an unimplemented rebuild. Driver-segment privacy, driver attribution and journey distance remain unavailable, so no fleet history is exposed through driver-only grants.
Requires settings.read. An absent row has version 1 and empty settings. Values are stored only; offline-state and unidentified-driving evaluators are not implemented.

patch.summary: Merge typed settings with optimistic concurrency
patch.description: Requires settings.write. Unknown setting keys are rejected. Existing keys not supplied are retained; stored values do not claim device configuration delivery.

telemetry_interval_seconds.description: Must also meet paid-plan minimum interval. Publish signed vehicle configuration separately.

email_digest_hour.description: Generate after this hour in organization timezone; prior completed day only.

email_weekly_iso_day.description: 1 Monday to 7 Sunday; seven completed local days.

email_score_changes.description: Daily retained-history score comparison; never a calibrated safety finding. Account/security notices cannot be disabled.

get.summary: Cursor-page tenant members and their current permissions
get.description: Requires members.read. Returns membership ID, user ID, legacy primary role, status, version and effective permission keys. This is not an invitation endpoint.

patch.summary: Update a tenant member's status or role assignments
patch.description: Requires members.manage and the current version. The first role is the legacy primary role; effective grants are the union. Granting/removing owner roles uses ownership-transfers. Owner status changes additionally require ownership.transfer, email-link verification within 10 minutes, and another active owner. Target IDs are tenant-scoped.

items.description: Existing role code. Owner transitions require the dedicated endpoint.

post.summary: Atomically transfer ownership to an active tenant member
post.description: Requires ownership.transfer and a stateful session verified through an email link within 10 minutes. Target version must match. The target becomes owner, initiator becomes admin, and additional roles on those two memberships are cleared. Passwords and OAuth are not supported.

get.summary: Query this tenant's HTTP lifecycle projections
get.description: Requires request_logs.read. Half-open UTC window is limited to 31 days. Only authenticated tenant-associated rows are returned; context contains bounded untrusted browser claims and never raw request bodies, URLs or secrets.

get.summary: Query this tenant's delivered action records
get.description: Requires audit.read. Window is limited to 31 days. Committed outbox actions may not be visible until delivery; lack of a delivered row does not prove that no mutation happened.

Requires telemetry.read. Half-open UTC window is limited to 24 hours. Returned speed/RPM/GPS values are nullable; unusable clocks, stale or installation-mismatched observations are not presented as valid measurements. The inbox stores privacy-sanitized JSON, not original replay bytes; the original wire SHA-256 is retained. DTC codes are never persisted.

get.summary: Cursor-page raw position samples with explicit gaps
get.description: Requires telemetry.read and a window no wider than 24 hours. This implementation does not downsample or interpolate a map trace. Null positions remain gaps; it does not infer positions from packet timestamps.

get.summary: Latest normalized vehicle, network, health and behavior snapshot
get.description: Requires telemetry.read. Returns nullable sample, freshness and explicit quality. Pi clock quality is unreported; edge behavior flags are unverified, and driver_session cannot authenticate a shift. No data returns sample null.

get.summary: Latest reported fault presence without stored codes
get.description: Requires telemetry.read and active paid access. Codes are stripped before persistence; only MIL/fault presence remains. Unknown or false presence is not proof of a complete ECU scan or confirmed clearance. Use POST dtc-ai for a transient code explanation.

Requires analytics.read. Uses direct rates or MAF only for server-registered petrol vehicles with AFR 14.7 and density 745 g/L. Integrates compatible packet rates over at most 15 seconds with exact clipped boundaries. No usable coverage gives null fuel, not zero. Edge cumulative totals are ignored. CO2 remains null without an approved factor. Does not implement driver or journey energy attribution.

get.summary: Cursor-paged GPS and network packet observations
get.description: Requires coverage.read. Raw windows limited to 24 hours. Network sample timing and location alignment are unverified. Missing telemetry is not proof of a dead zone. No grid aggregation or radio-quality classification is inferred.

get.summary: Cursor-paged active fleet states and map coordinates
get.description: Requires both dashboard.read and telemetry.read. Never-observed or stale states are explicit. Staleness is not a confirmed device/network outage.
Requires dashboard.read. Counts vehicles, observed vehicles, current authorized shifts, active automatic journeys, open alerts and pending telemetry. Does not infer passenger fares or earnings.

get.summary: Cursor-page invitation history without bearer secrets
get.description: Requires members.manage. Includes accepted, revoked and expired records.

post.summary: Record a mailbox-bound invitation and encrypted mail intent
post.description: Requires members.manage and non-logging mail transport. Owner cannot be granted by invitation. Existing memberships and live duplicate invitations return 409. Matching idempotent replay returns the same ID; mismatched replay returns 409. New invitees get an eligible email-link account, but no tenant membership until explicit authenticated acceptance.
Requires members.manage. Repeated revocation succeeds; accepted invitations return 409. Worker rechecks revocation before sending mail.

post.summary: Explicitly accept a single-use invitation as its authenticated mailbox owner
post.description: Requires an active email-link-authenticated account matching the invited normalized email. The target organization must be active. Existing membership returns 409, wrong mailbox 403, invalid/expired/revoked/consumed token 422. No GET consumes invitation tokens.

get.description: Public, rate limited. Up to 200 active positive-priced MYR plans, ordered by price/id; no provider credentials or inactive plans. Price is in minor units. No free/default plans are invented. payment_window_hours is 12.

post.description: Rate limited and enumeration-safe. Creates a mailbox identity if unknown, but no organization/membership/authority before explicit confirmation. Optional organization contains the reviewed signup details and requires Idempotency-Key; encrypted backend intent expires after 10 minutes. Exact key replay queues no new email and cannot change the draft. Explicit single-use magic-links/consume rechecks plan/version and transactionally creates owner, organization and invoice; returns /signup?signup=UUID&checkout=1. No charge occurs during confirmation. Email-only legacy onboarding remains supported. Suspended accounts remain ineligible. Accepted is not delivery. Credentialed CORS and CSRF required.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required when organization is supplied. Replays never replace the encrypted draft or send another email.

get.summary: Reconcile the current account's latest organization signup
get.description: Active authenticated account only. Returns signup and invoice (null when absent/deleted). Signup includes id, organization_id, invoice_id, status pending/paid/deleted, fixed payment_due_at, deadline_passed, paid_at and deleted_at. No request hashes. Invoice includes server-priced plan_snapshot but no checkout bearer URL. Deleted tombstones never restore tenant access.

post.summary: Create an organization with an initial plan invoice
post.description: Active authenticated account; new creation requires email-link verification within 10 minutes. Owner role is assigned to the authenticated user, never a body-supplied identity. Server locks user and selected plan, checks plan_version, sets the price/snapshot and a fixed 12-hour deadline. One pending signup/account, at most 3 creations/day. Pending organization is billing-only regardless of subscription feature flags. No charge/subscription activation occurs here. Exact payload/key replay returns original signup, even a deleted tombstone, without extending the deadline; edited key reuse is 409. After deadline, no checkout or settlement is permitted; scheduled child-first permanent deletion retains separate encrypted financial and audit evidence. Existing organizations and all paid signups are excluded. Provider links cannot be cancelled: late callbacks require operator reconciliation and never resurrect the tenant.

get.summary: Reconcile a signup owned by the current account
get.description: Same safe data as the latest signup endpoint; another account's ID returns 404, including deleted tombstones.

get.summary: List permanently deleted unpaid signup financial archives
get.description: Independent active SaaS admin only. Cursor-paginated signup tombstones with payments_requiring_reconciliation counts. Not tenant-accessible. Financial archives and action audits have no organization FK and survive permanent tenant deletion.

get.summary: Inspect archived signup invoices and late-payment evidence
get.description: Independent active SaaS admin only. Decrypts retained organization billing identity, invoice/plan snapshots, original payment/events, mail delivery metadata and subscription, plus post-deletion events and reconciliation_required payment markers. Never exposes callback hashes or checkout URLs. Late callbacks/provider responses are evidence for manual provider/bank reconciliation, not a refund or a replacement payment API. Keep APP_KEY and backups available to decrypt financial archives.
Active independent SaaS admin only. Includes inactive plans.

post.description: SaaS admin only. MYR prices are integer minor units. No default/free plan is seeded.

patch.description: SaaS admin only. Version required. Existing paid subscription and invoice snapshots remain unchanged. Inactive plans cannot receive new invoices.

get.description: SaaS admin only. access_active accounts for expiry; status alone does not prove paid access.

patch.description: SaaS admin only. Activation cannot grant time: an unexpired paid period is required. Payment does not override suspension/deactivation.

get.description: SaaS admin only; tenant roles confer no platform authority.

post.description: SaaS admin and email-link verification within 10 minutes required. New staff must request their own email link. No password is generated.

patch.description: SaaS admin and recent email-link verification required. The last active administrator cannot be suspended.

get.description: SaaS admin only. MYR paid-invoice total is not independently reconciled bank revenue.
SaaS admin only. At most 31 days per query. No tenant association, raw URL, bodies or credentials are returned.

post.description: SaaS admin only, 10/minute. Sends strictly PII-scrubbed platform device, subscription, alert, and API error aggregates to Google Gemini using configured gemini-3.5-flash-lite. Transient; prompts and outputs are not persisted.

get.description: SaaS admin/technician. Device UUID, organization name and vehicle plate/make/model only; no static token.
SaaS staff only. online is null without samples, otherwise packet freshness within 180 seconds—not proven connectivity. Technicians additionally receive network and health claims.

post.description: Active SaaS technician only; ordinary SaaS admins receive 403. Optimistic version guard; this does not itself test a BLE connection.

Active SaaS technician only, 6/minute; ordinary SaaS admins receive 403. Credential-bearing response, private/no-store. Returns one-line setup command to download carlink-telemetry-agent executable and configure carlink-device.json. Does not provision RabbitMQ.

Active SaaS technician only; ordinary SaaS admins receive 403. Saved MAC, managed token and BROKER_VERIFIED_TOPIC_ACLS gate required. Records operator attestation, not proof of broker provisioning or hardware installation.
SaaS admin only. Same-organization, one open link per device and per vehicle; append-only history starts now.
SaaS admin only. Closes active driver attribution and cancels outstanding commands. Historical links remain.

get.description: SaaS admin only. Returns vehicle UUID, registration number, make, model, status and linked device UUID only; no location, driver or telemetry fields.

get.description: subscription.read; snapshots survive later plan edits. No subscription means no paid access when enforcement is enabled.

post.description: payments.manage. Invoice amount and payee come from server records. Existing permanent payment attempts must be reconciled before another attempt.

telemetry.read and paid access, 10/minute. Sends the code to Google using configured gemini-3.5-flash-lite stream JSON configuration. TCU is normalized to TCM; invalid/malformed/word-limit output returns 502. No prompts, codes or explanations are persisted. Not a confirmed diagnosis.

diagnostics.run. Fresh received/observed speed exactly 0 km/h, current installation and no pending command required. Pi must independently check stationary OBD speed, pause polling, bound execution to 300 seconds and restore polling. No diagnostic result is stored.

get.description: devices.read; no codes, AI explanation, command credentials or raw scans are returned.

post.summary: Queue signed telemetry and fuel settings
post.description: device_config.publish. Applies plan minimum interval and cellular/safety gates. Queued is not proof of application by the Pi.

get.description: drivers.read. Coordinates require matching current NFC shift; packet time is returned and must not be presented as verified live location. data.pagination includes next_cursor, previous_cursor and per_page; follow cursors until null. No pre-pagination history cap; ordering has unique tie-breakers.

coverage.read or coverage.export, plus cellular plan feature. UTC window at most 24 hours. export=true returns CSV inside the seven-field JSON envelope; at most 10000 rows, formula-leading strings escaped, unknown RSRP/SINR blank.
reports.read. Snapshot counts, not a full calibrated analytics/reporting suite.
compliance.read. Cursor-paginated compliance records with obligation and subject metadata.
maintenance.read. Evaluates active vehicle maintenance assignments and current cycles.

post.description: drivers.write. Versioned PNG/JPEG upload; never served through a public storage symlink.

get.description: drivers.read or matching active own driver with profile.own. S3 photos return item plus a direct S3 SigV4 bearer link valid for at most 300 seconds. Authorization is checked at issuance; issued URLs do not require a CarLink session and cannot be immediately revoked by app access changes. Existing private local files are preserved but return reupload_required=true without file bytes until explicitly reuploaded through validation; never silently deleted.
safety.read and safety feature. Experimental 100 minus 5 per observation; null without sufficient samples, uncalibrated and not distance-normalized. Approved appeals excluded.
safety.read and safety feature. Retention-limited; edge harsh-driving flags do not determine scores.
safety.appeals.decide and safety feature. Retention-limited.

post.description: audit.read and paid access. Explains audit actions.

get.description: EDGE ONLY. Per-device static Bearer token, active installation/subscription. Returns organization settings synchronized to device.
EDGE ONLY. Per-device static Bearer token, active installation/subscription. wire_payload is the exact UTF-8 HMAC-SHA256 input, keyed by the device token. Do not reserialize before verifying.

post.description: EDGE ONLY. Per-device token and current installation. Start extended scan with local speed exactly zero observed within two seconds; server freshness checked again. Terminal results contain status only. Unknown fields and codes/raw/result are prohibited.
EDGE ONLY. Per-device token and paid access; 10/minute. Sends transient code to Google; does not persist input/output or confer human authentication.

EDGE ONLY. Per-device static Bearer token, active installation/subscription. Server resolves active installation; unknown fields and client installation_id/driver_id/organization_id/codes are prohibited. Never returns credential fingerprints.

get.description: Active tenant membership and subscription required. Target-specific organizations/drivers/vehicles/compliance/maintenance/mileage read or write permission is checked, never an unrelated files.manage bypass. Matching active drivers may read own driver attachments and their own/currently NFC-authorized compliance/maintenance evidence, never unrelated fleet files.

200.description: Seven-field JSON envelope. Link responses contain a confidential S3 bearer URL; never AWS secret keys.

post.description: Active tenant membership and subscription required. Target-specific organizations/drivers/vehicles/compliance/maintenance/mileage read or write permission is checked, never an unrelated files.manage bypass. Matching active drivers may read own driver attachments and their own/currently NFC-authorized compliance/maintenance evidence, never unrelated fleet files. JSON/base64 server upload only, 12/minute. MIME comes from contents, safe generated extension/name, bounded image dimensions, image decode/re-encode and metadata removal. PDFs receive basic header/version and EOF checks only, not full structure/encryption validation. No external validator binary or antivirus scan; not proof of malware-free contents. No direct-to-S3 uploads. Photos attach to organizations/drivers; driver replacement requires current version. Upload does not manually verify compliance or mileage.

201.description: Seven-field JSON envelope. Link responses contain a confidential S3 bearer URL; never AWS secret keys.

post.summary: Issue a five-minute direct S3 download link
post.description: Active tenant membership and subscription required. Target-specific organizations/drivers/vehicles/compliance/maintenance/mileage read or write permission is checked, never an unrelated files.manage bypass. Matching active drivers may read own driver attachments and their own/currently NFC-authorized compliance/maintenance evidence, never unrelated fleet files. Authorization/readiness is checked when issuing a private S3 GetObject SigV4 URL, valid for at most 300 seconds (temporary AWS credentials can expire sooner). Anyone holding the URL can use it without a CarLink session. Revocation, replacement, logout or membership suspension blocks new issuance, not already-issued URLs until expiry or object deletion. Signed response MIME/disposition/cache settings; images may be inline, PDFs always download. No PHP byte proxy or download-time hash check; successful presigning does not prove the object exists or is readable.

post.description: Active tenant membership and subscription required. Target-specific organizations/drivers/vehicles/compliance/maintenance/mileage read or write permission is checked, never an unrelated files.manage bypass. Matching active drivers may read own driver attachments and their own/currently NFC-authorized compliance/maintenance evidence, never unrelated fleet files. get.description: Active tenant membership and subscription required. Target-specific organizations/drivers/vehicles/compliance/maintenance/mileage read or write permission is checked, never an unrelated files.manage bypass. Matching active drivers may read own driver attachments and their own/currently NFC-authorized compliance/maintenance evidence, never unrelated fleet files. Authorization/readiness is checked when issuing a private S3 GetObject SigV4 URL, valid for at most 300 seconds (temporary AWS credentials can expire sooner). Anyone holding the URL can use it without a CarLink session. Revocation, replacement, logout or membership suspension blocks new issuance, not already-issued URLs until expiry or object deletion. Signed response MIME/disposition/cache settings; images may be inline, PDFs always download. No PHP byte proxy or download-time hash check; successful presigning does not prove the object exists or is readable. Breaking change from the former binary CarLink-HMAC route: now a standard JSON envelope containing item/link, never file bytes or a redirect.
